tools.name: get_hawaii_entry
tools.description: Get the full details of one Ask Hawaiʻi entry by its id (from search_hawaii results), including every detail line and source link.

tools.name: get_hawaii_weather
tools.description: Live forecast from the U.S. National Weather Service for a Hawaiʻi place, e.g. Honolulu, Haleʻiwa, Kahului, Haleakalā summit, Līhuʻe, Kona, Hilo or Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park.

tools.name: get_hawaii_alerts
tools.description: Active National Weather Service alerts in Hawaiʻi (high surf, flash flood, wind, tsunami and more), optionally filtered by island.

tools.name: get_hawaii_headlines
tools.description: Today's Hawaiʻi news headlines (titles and links) from Hawaii News Now, KHON2 and Civil Beat. Updated twice a day, at 7 a.m. and 7 p.m. Hawaiʻi time.

tools.name: list_hawaii_topics
tools.description: List every topic Ask Hawaiʻi covers, grouped by category, with ids.
